title: Two paddle table tennis game
when: The user wants the retro two paddle ball game, for two players on one keyboard or against a computer paddle.
prompt:
Goal: Fair serves, aimable returns and a computer paddle that can be beaten.
Steps:
1. Court 800 by 500 logical units scaled to fit; fixed 1/120 s physics steps from a requestAnimationFrame accumulator.
2. logic.mjs step(state, dt, inputs): bounce angle from hit offset, 5 percent speed up per hit with a cap, point when the ball passes an edge, serve toward the player who lost it.
3. Two players: W and S, ArrowUp and ArrowDown; versus computer: the paddle tracks the ball with a max speed and reaction delay per difficulty.
4. Touch: each half of the screen drags its own paddle with pointer events.
5. First to 7 by default; score in a text HUD announced via aria-live; P pauses.
6. test.mjs: bounce angles, scoring side, computer speed limit, reset after a point.
Quality bar:
- Computer misses sometimes at Easy and Normal.
- Paddles cannot leave the court.
- Center line and score readable.
Pitfalls:
- Ball sticking inside a paddle.
- Both players fighting over one key handler.
- Speed tied to frame rate.
Verify:
- [ ] Physics tested.
- [ ] Score live.
- [ ] Pause works.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, game.js, logic.mjs (physics and computer paddle), test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo de tenis de mesa retro para dois jogadores
examples.output: W/S vs arrows, computer mode, first to 7
